# x-use

> Browserless X (Twitter) CLI & Node.js SDK built to connect any AI model or AI agent (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini, Meta Muse, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, Ollama, OpenClaw, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGPT, MCP servers, and custom autonomous agents) to X over pure HTTPS—with an encrypted cookie vault, persistent rate limiter, and circuit breaker.

## Overview

`x-use` (`xuse` / `agent-x-use`) lets AI agents read timelines, search posts, fetch profiles and notifications, and publish tweets, replies, threads, likes, and retweets without launching Chromium, Puppeteer, or Playwright.

- **Website:** https://dalroot.github.io/x-use/
- **Full LLM Reference:** https://dalroot.github.io/x-use/llms-full.txt
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dalroot/x-use
- **Runtime:** Node.js `>=20.19.0` (Pure HTTPS + X GraphQL + `x-client-transaction-id`)
- **License:** PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0

## Documentation for Agents & Crawlers

- [llms-full.txt](https://dalroot.github.io/x-use/llms-full.txt): Complete single-file reference with CLI commands, Node.js SDK examples, JSON schema, exit codes, and safety rules.
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dalroot/x-use/main/SKILL.md): Operational skill file for AI agents (`0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4` exit codes and `--json` contract).
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dalroot/x-use/main/AGENTS.md): Standard repository and safety rules for AI coding and CLI agents.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dalroot/x-use/main/README.md): Full installation, Node.js SDK, proxy support, and encrypted cookie vault documentation.

## Safety & Anti-Ban Architecture

- **1 Attempt Per Request:** Single HTTPS request with 35s timeout; no blind retry loops.
- **Persistent Rate Limiter:** Default 50 reads per 15 minutes (3–6s jitter) and 15 writes per 60 minutes (15–30s jitter).
- **Circuit Breaker:** Trips after 2 consecutive errors or immediately on HTTP `401`, `403`, or `429`.
- **Encrypted Cookie Vault:** AES-256-GCM encrypted credentials stored in `~/.x-use/` with `0600` permissions.
- **Human Confirmation Required:** Agents must always ask the user before executing write actions (`tweet`, `reply`, `thread`, `like`, `retweet`, `delete`).
